sections.title: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property

rows.label: Corporate income tax [national]
rows.value: 25% or 30% for domestic companies, 22% or 15% under the optional regimes, 35% for foreign companies, plus surcharge and 4% cess; MAT of 14% on book profit. Paid by companies resident in India on worldwide income, and foreign companies on income from India. Income-tax Act, 2025 sections 200, 201 and 206; Finance Act, 2026 First Schedule. In force from 2026-04-01.

source.title: Finance Act, 2026 (No. 4 of 2026), section 3(1) and First Schedule Part I-B Paragraph E and Part III Paragraph E; Income-tax Act, 2025 (No. 30 of 2025), sections 200 and 201

rows.label: Tax on branch profits and distributed profits [national]
rows.value: none; dividends are taxed in the shareholder's hands, with 10% withheld for residents and 20% for non-residents. Paid by no one (shareholders pay income tax on dividends). Income-tax Act, 2025 sections 7(2) and 393. In force from 2026-04-01.

source.title: Income-tax Act, 2025 (No. 30 of 2025), sections 7(2), 9(4) and 393(1) Table Sl.7; Finance Act, 2026 First Schedule Part I-B Paragraph E

rows.label: Self-employed contributions [national]
rows.value: none compulsory; government welfare schemes for unorganised workers. Paid by no one. Code on Social Security, 2020 sections 2(75), 2(86) and 109. In force from 2025-11-21.

source.title: Code on Social Security, 2020 (No. 36 of 2020), sections 2(26), 2(75), 2(85), 2(86), 15(1)(d) and 109 (in force from 21 November 2025)

rows.label: Contractor payments: tax deducted at source [national]
rows.value: 1% or 2% on contract work, 10% on professional fees (2% on technical fees). Paid by contractors and professionals (deducted by the payer). Income-tax Act, 2025 section 393(1) Table Sl.6. In force from 2026-04-01.

source.title: Income-tax Act, 2025, section 393(1) Table Sl.6(i) (formerly section 194C of the 1961 Act)

rows.label: Presumptive taxation of small businesses and professionals [national]
rows.value: deemed profit of 6% or 8% of business turnover up to ₹2 crore (₹3 crore with little cash), 50% of professional receipts up to ₹50 lakh (₹75 lakh). Paid by resident individuals, HUFs and firms that choose it. Income-tax Act, 2025 section 58. In force from 2026-04-01.

source.title: Income-tax Act, 2025, section 58(2) Table Sl.1, 58(4), 58(7) and 58(11)(a) (formerly section 44AD); Finance Act, 2026 section 40

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
rows.value: normal slab rates on salary for services rendered in India, withheld by the employer; resident after 182 days in the tax year. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). Income-tax Act, 2025 sections 6, 9(3), 392 and Schedule IV. In force from 2026-04-01.

source.title: Income-tax Act, 2025, sections 5, 9(3), 156(1), 159 and 392(1); Finance Act, 2026 First Schedule Part I-B and Part III

rows.label: Property tax (municipal) [local]
rows.value: rates and base set by each municipality; states notify floor rates. Paid by owners of buildings and land in municipal areas. state municipal laws.

source.title: Press Information Bureau: Finance Commission holds meeting with MoHUA on Property Taxation by ULBs (17 July 2020)

rows.label: Stamp duty and registration on property transfers [state]
rows.value: 4% to 7% of the market value in the states read (Maharashtra, Delhi, West Bengal), set by each state; registration fee 1% in Delhi. Paid by the buyer. state stamp laws; Registration Act, 1908.
